turns.text:
**Charm decides the lane.** Ahri can aim it where Shunpo lands, so threaten a dagger pickup without taking it. When Charm misses, **Shunpo in**, trade, then leave before her return damage. Its cooldown is 12 seconds; make that window count.

- Level 1: **Take Q and farm safely.** Do not give up health to contest Ahri's faster push.
- Levels 2–5: With Q then E, **trade after Charm misses**, especially if Orb of Deception also misses. Use W once available to set up another dagger, but do not Shunpo onto a dagger Ahri is already aiming at. If Charm stays up, hold the wave near your side and collect farm rather than forcing a crash.
- Level 6: **All-in when Charm is down and Ahri is low enough to finish.** If Spirit Rush is available, expect her to escape the first commitment; take the short trade or force it out first. Do not channel Death Lotus into available Charm.

Runes: Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, Relentless Hunter; Coup de Grace, Triumph; Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Health Scaling; Flash, Ignite  
Build: Dark Seal + Refillable Potion → Aether Wisp → Lich Bane → Sorcerer's Shoes → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass  
Skills: Q > E > W, then max Q > E > W

First back: **buy Aether Wisp when you can afford its 900 gold** and return to the wave. Don't sacrifice a wave chasing a roam while Ahri can shove it back.

data.tip: Avoid engagments early-game, but you can try to deal damage utilizing [Q]-[E] later on when you have purchased items mid-game. Keep in mind that Ahri will always aim her (E) right after Katarina uses her [E], so be sure to move after using [E].

results.snippet: Your level 2 all-in beats her level 2 if you start E and take Q second – E onto her, auto, Q, pick up dagger, E again. … Before six, you win every trade if you dodge her charm. … You never Shunpo onto her without seeing her ultimate down.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide: Trick of the Tails
results.snippet: The one thing I will say for this matchup is abuse your auto attacks towards her. … Because of the way her daggers enable her to deal extra damage and grant her extra mobility, it's extremely important that you always stay away from any dagger that's down. … When she picks up a dagger, it also refunds almost the entire cooldown on Shunpo.

results.title: Katarina Build Guide: Katarina Assassin Build + 35 TRICKS (VIDEO)
results.snippet: Level 1, you will get poked by ranged champs, so you need to stay back if they show they will poke you. … Level 2, you can look for a trade. If they aren't level 2 or if they missed an ability, use Q and instant Shunpo onto the dagger while it is still in the air or behind the opponent. … Level 3-5, you can Q, wait, then see if they stay around the dagger.

data.answer: For Katarina, survive Ahri’s level 1 poke; at level 2, an E-start all-in can win if you dodge Charm, and level 3 gives you fuller dagger trades. Avoid her daggers and don’t Shunpo onto her without accounting for Charm; the pages found don’t specify a first-back item.
